hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: How we handle the information you share with us

intro: This policy explains what personal information Uplevel Restoration collects through uplevelcorp.ca, why we collect it, who we share it with, and the choices you have. It applies to this website only — not to information you give us over the phone, by email, or on site during a restoration job.
We follow Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA).

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Uplevel Restoration Corp. operates this website and is responsible for the personal information described here.
Mailing address: #1-702 45th Street West, Saskatoon, SK, Canada

sections.title: Information you give us
paragraphs: When you submit the contact form on our "Get in Touch" page, we collect the information you type into it:
sections.footnote: We do not ask for payment details, insurance policy numbers, or identification documents through this website. Please do not include them in the form message.

sections.title: Information collected automatically
paragraphs: Like most websites, ours receives standard technical information when you visit — such as your IP address, browser type, device type, the pages you view, and the site or ad that referred you. Our advertising and anti-spam providers (listed below) collect this on our behalf using cookies and similar technologies.
We do not run general website analytics such as Google Analytics, and we do not build profiles of individual visitors ourselves.

sections.title: How we use your information
items: To respond to your enquiry and provide the restoration services you ask about
To contact you about an active or prospective job
To protect the contact form from automated spam and abuse
To measure whether our advertising is reaching people who need our services
sections.footnote: We do not use what you send through the form for marketing. Your enquiry goes to our inbox and stays there — we do not add you to mailing lists, and we do not upload your name, email, or phone number to advertising platforms. Our advertising measurement counts that an enquiry happened; it does not receive what you wrote.

sections.title: Service providers we share it with
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with the providers that make this website work:
items: Web3Forms — delivers contact form submissions to our email. Everything you enter in the form passes through and is stored on their systems.
Google (Gmail) — the mailbox that receives those enquiries. Your message is stored there while we deal with it.
hCaptcha (Intuition Machines, Inc.) — spam protection on the contact form. It receives technical information about your device and browsing behaviour to tell humans from bots.

Google Ads (Google LLC) — advertising and conversion measurement. It records that a form submission happened and, where cookies allow, connects it to an ad you clicked. The form's contents are not sent to Google.
HOSTIQ — web hosting. It stores the website files and standard server logs, which include visitor IP addresses.
sections.footnote: These providers operate outside Canada — Web3Forms, hCaptcha and Google in the United States, and our hosting with HOSTIQ in Ukraine — so your information may be stored or processed there and may be accessible to foreign authorities under the laws of those countries.

sections.title: Cookies and advertising
paragraphs: This site sets cookies through Google Ads to measure conversions and, if enabled in the ad account, to show you our ads on other sites. It sets no cookies of its own beyond what these providers require.

You can control this in several ways: adjust your Google ad settings at myadcenter.google.com, opt out of interest-based advertising at youradchoices.ca, or block and delete cookies in your browser settings. Blocking these cookies does not affect your ability to use the site or submit the form.
Fonts on this site are served from our own server, so viewing a page does not send a request to any font provider.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Enquiries that do not lead to work are deleted within 12 months.

When an enquiry becomes a job, your contact details stay with that job's record — including the invoices held in our own customer management system — for seven years after the work is finished. We keep them that long because insurers, warranty claims, and tax rules can require the paperwork years after a restoration is complete. We delete them once that period ends.

sections.title: How we protect it
paragraphs: This site is served over an encrypted connection (HTTPS), and form submissions are transmitted encrypted. Access to enquiry emails is limited to the owner and office staff.
No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under PIPEDA you may ask us to:
items: Tell you what personal information we hold about you and how it has been used
Correct information that is inaccurate or incomplete
Delete information we no longer need to keep
Withdraw your consent to being contacted for marketing purposes
sections.footnote: Write to uplevel@uplevelcorp.ca and we will respond within 30 days. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada at priv.gc.ca.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: This website is intended for property owners and managers. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has submitted information through our form, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy as our services or the tools we use change. The effective date at the top of the page shows when it was last revised. Material changes will be posted on this page.

sections.title: Contact us
paragraphs: Questions about this policy or about the information we hold: uplevel@uplevelcorp.ca or (306) 850-5955.
Uplevel Restoration Corp., #1-702 45th Street West, Saskatoon, SK, Canada
